name: Clometacin

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France, first in 1987 — for liver harm

similar.name: Indomethacin
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for nerve and brain harm, stomach and gut problems and heart harm

similar.name: Clofibrate
problems: Pulled from the market in Israel and 2 other countries, first in 1979 — for blood vessel problems and cancer risk

summary: Clometacin was removed from the market in France starting in 1987 due to liver damage [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a high liver risk score of 80 and a low heart risk score of 28 for this drug [M]. A similar drug called Indomethacin has a severe warning label in the United States for heart harm, nerve and brain harm, and stomach and gut problems [4]. Another similar drug named Clofibrate was taken off the market in Israel and two other countries because of cancer risks and blood vessel problems [5].
